items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: You know, like with Elvis Presley -- I'm goin' in that area now... Otis Blackwell -- we used to make demonstration records that he used to send down to Nashville for Presley to learn.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was his first hit. You know, like with Elvis Presley -- I'm goin' in that area now. Now, Elvis Presley -- there was a guy named Otis Blackwell -- he wrote "Don't Be Cruel" for Presley and "All Shook Up" -- these were all written by Otis Blackwell.
Right, I know him very well.
